meta.name: Generate SEO-audited blog posts with internal links from forms using OpenAI

name: SEO Blog Post Generator with Internal Linking and Self-Audit

parameters.content:
## SEO Blog Post Generator with Internal Linking & Self-Audit
Submit a topic and get back a publish-ready post that links to pages already on your site, and that has audited and corrected its own SEO before you ever read it.

## How it works
1. Submit a topic, target keyword, and optionally your sitemap URL
2. Your sitemap is read to collect real URLs the post can link to
3. AI outlines, then writes the full post - inserting internal links only from those real URLs
4. A second AI pass scores the draft against 8 concrete SEO rules and rewrites it, looping once if it still fails
5. You get the finished markdown plus a short audit report, and the run is logged to a sheet

## Setup
- [ ] Connect your OpenAI credentials in OpenAI Chat Model
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets credentials in Log To Sheet, pick your spreadsheet and tab
- [ ] That sheet needs these column headers: Date, Topic, Keyword, Title, Word Count, Audit, Notes
- [ ] Optionally swap the model - gpt-4o-mini is cheap and fine here

The sitemap field is optional. Leave it blank and the workflow still runs, it just writes without internal links instead of inventing them. Logging is also non-blocking - if the sheet is wrong you still get your post.

## Customize
Edit the 8 checks in Audit And Improve to match your own SEO standards. Change the revision limit in Passed Or Max Attempts.

## 1. Real Internal Links
Reads your sitemap and collects actual URLs from your site, so the post links to pages that exist. Optional - skip it and the post is written without internal links.

## 2. Outline & Draft
Outline first, then the full post written against it - with internal links pulled only from the URL list above.

## 3. Self-Audit Loop & Output
A second AI pass scores the draft against 8 SEO rules and rewrites it. Fails again, it loops back once, then ships the best version with an audit report and logs the run.

parameters.formDescription: Get a publish-ready post that links to your existing pages and audits its own SEO.

parameters.text:
=You are an SEO content strategist. Build the outline for a blog post.

Topic: {{ $json.topic }}
Target keyword: {{ $json.keyword }}

Produce:
- The angle, in one line. Say what this post argues or delivers that a generic article on the topic would not.
- 4-6 H2 section headers, phrased the way someone would actually search for that sub-question
- 2-3 concrete points each section must cover
- 3-5 related terms and phrases to work in naturally

Be specific. "Benefits of X" and "Getting started with X" are the headers every weak post uses - do better than that.

Plain text, clearly structured.

=You are an SEO copywriter. Write the full post from this outline.

Topic: {{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.topic }}
Target keyword: {{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.keyword }}
Target length: about {{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.wordCount }} words

Outline:
{{ $json.text }}

URLs from this site you may link to internally:
{{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.internalLinks }}

Rules:
- Open with the answer. No throat-clearing, no "in today's fast-paced world".
- Use ## for each H2 from the outline.
- Insert 2-4 internal links using ONLY the URLs listed above, as markdown links, where they genuinely fit the sentence. If the list says NONE, include no internal links at all. Never invent or guess a URL.
- Put the target keyword in the title, in the first 100 words, and in at least one H2 - naturally, not stuffed.
- No invented statistics, no fabricated quotes, no fake sources.

Output in exactly this markdown structure and nothing else:

# <SEO title, 60 characters or fewer>

**Meta description:** <150-160 characters>

<full post body>

=You are an SEO editor. Audit the draft below, then return a corrected version.

Target keyword: {{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.keyword }}
Target length: about {{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.wordCount }} words

Allowed internal link URLs - any link not on this list is a failure:
{{ $('Extract Internal Links').item.json.internalLinks }}

DRAFT:
{{ $json.draft }}

Check each of these, pass or fail:
1. Title is 60 characters or fewer and contains the target keyword
2. Meta description is between 150 and 160 characters
3. Target keyword appears in the first 100 words of the body
4. At least one H2 contains the target keyword or a close variant
5. Heading hierarchy is clean - no skipped levels, no headings used as decoration
6. Word count is within 20 percent of the target
7. Every internal link points at a URL from the allowed list (if the list says NONE, there must be no internal links at all)
8. No invented statistics, fabricated quotes, or made-up sources

Fix every failure yourself. Keep the author's substance - correct it, do not rewrite from scratch.

Return ONLY raw JSON, no code fences, no commentary, in exactly this shape:
{"passed": true or false, "issues": ["short description of each check that failed"], "improvedDraft": "the complete corrected post in the same markdown structure"}

"passed" describes the draft BEFORE your corrections - if you changed anything, passed is false. improvedDraft must always contain the full post.
